props.text: This probe isolates root variables, fallbacks, selector-local variables, embedded var() values, calc(), and the current no-inheritance limitation.
Missing variables fall back to width, background, and border values.
Variables declared in this rule are reused by the same rule block.
var() is used inside border, shadow, and layered background values.
Width, min-width, and padding use variables inside calc().
This text should use the fallback color, because --child-color does not inherit into a separate child selector yet.
